Companion Animal Travel Desk Pet Weight Limits
This section sets clear guidance for traveling with companion animals through Aurelia Skyways.

At the Companion Animal Travel Desk, the senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions so each request is handled with consistency and care. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and staff record service changes in the desk ledger to keep travel arrangements reliable and transparent. When a traveler approaches with a companion animal, staff verify eligibility, confirm that the requested itinerary can accommodate the animal, and coordinate with relevant departments to prevent delays or misunderstandings.

For rabbit travel specifically, the Companion Animal Travel Desk applies the allowed total for the pet and its crate together, and staff treat that limit as non-negotiable when planning acceptance. <<FACT F064>> During the check-in process, the traveler is asked to present the animal and crate as they will travel, and staff ensure the crate is secure, appropriate for movement, and free from unnecessary obstructions.

Travelers may be reassured that if the service changes affect the animal's handling or seating arrangements, staff will note the adjustment in the desk ledger and keep the traveler informed in plain language. If a traveler named Ben Ibrahim or Nikhil Nakamura is assisting Milolet, staff will still follow the same verification steps, with attention focused on the animal's welfare and the integrity of the booking.

If circumstances require escalation, staff will coordinate promptly and document each decision with the travel desk ledger entry. For support or clarification, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk directly.
